evidence.exact_quote: canonical_text: Standardized Plans may generate plan_units.jsonl, doc_cards.json, dependencies.json, acceptance_units.jsonl, coverage_report.json, and node_readiness_report.json under Plans/.plan_index/. evidence.exact_quote: canonical_text: Every PlanUnit carries a simple agent-inferred gui_related boolean. Native Puppet Master should expose a simple setting such as "use different model for GUI elements?" so gui_related work can route to a configured GUI model when enabled.

items.impact: Implementers must invent configuration scope, persistence, activation timing, invalid-model behavior, fallback behavior, permission boundaries, disabled-state projection, and observable failure states; different consumers could route the same work differently or mislead users about which model will run.
items.statement: PDS-007 specifies the boolean and a visible setting concept but does not define the setting's complete state machine, persistence and propagation semantics, authorization, model validation, unavailable-model fallback, or user-visible error and recovery contract.
items.title: PDS-007 leaves GUI model routing behavior underspecified

evidence.exact_quote: canonical_text: A PlanUnit block is a fenced YAML block containing exactly one mapping with unique keys. Each PlanUnit is extracted from live non-pipeline Plans docs into generated indexes. Required fields keep stable identity, lifecycle status, owner_doc, canonical_text, gui_related, source_lineage, dependency edges, acceptance criteria, validation surfaces, risk_class, reasoning_tier, context_scope, implementation_surfaces, and node_compile_hint machine-readable.

items.impact: Duplicate plan_unit_id values across documents, concurrent edits, or partial index writes could yield nondeterministic identity and consumer-visible mixed generations even though each individual YAML mapping has unique keys.
items.statement: PDS-008 rejects YAML duplicate keys but does not state the global PlanUnit-ID uniqueness domain, collision disposition, deterministic extraction order, atomic publication rule, or recovery behavior when extraction fails after only part of an index generation.
items.title: PDS-008 omits global identity collision and atomic extraction rules

segments.summary: Reviewed the prologue and PDS-001 through PDS-008. Ownership, profiles, field shape, lossless conversion, owner adjudication, and the index-only boundary are explicit; material negative-space gaps remain in GUI model routing, global PlanUnit identity, and atomic extraction failure behavior.

Reviewed PDS-009 through PDS-014 and the compilation coverage tail. The layout/profile contracts are strong, while migration transaction recovery, new-profile discovery, deterministic finding-key canonicalization, and concurrent closure writes remain underdefined.

Reviewed PDS-015 through PDS-019 and their addenda. The assigned text exposes high-impact gaps in reference-scan completeness, plan-pack reconciliation, retired-content retrieval, imported-owner adjudication, and blocker-state authority.

Reviewed PDS-020 and all FABLE repair notes. The executable-proof boundary is explicit, but closure authority and immutable evidence binding are missing, and the GUI-routing repair note is not propagated into its addressable PlanUnit contract.
